cards.title: Core idea
cards.body: Module 6 puts it together under time pressure: timed practice on TryHackMe and VulnHub, a 6-hour self-made mock with a pivot, a one-screen exam-day cheat sheet, then booking the voucher.

cards.title: How it works
cards.body: Exam day: map the whole network first (nmap -sn, all ports, then services and versions), enumerate every service before exploiting. Your notes file is your biggest asset since it is open-book and unproctored. You get two attempts; a retake must be used within 14 days.

questions.q: What should you do first on exam day?
questions.a: Map the whole network: live hosts, all ports, then services and versions.

questions.q: How long is the retake window?
questions.a: A failed attempt's retake must be used within 14 days.

questions.q: What is your biggest asset in the exam?
questions.a: Your notes file, since it is open-book and unproctored.
